props.name: aiSuggestion
props.description: AI suggestion config (object or JSON string): { enabled, regenerable, source }. When `enabled`, the editor gets the Moshammer AI highlight and overlays the `actions` slot (regenerate / dismiss) at the top of the content area.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show a live `current/max` character counter below the editor. Requires `max`. Counter follows the document direction so it stays anchored when the editor's own dir flips for per-language RTL. Turns danger-red under `has-error`.

slots.name: startSlot

slots.name: content
slots.description: Default slot, raw HTML for the tooltip body. It accepts any markup: paragraphs, lists, media, `s-tooltip-action` or `s-button` actions.

slots.name: title
slots.description: title` slot, the content is rendered inside `<h4 slot="title">` so inline markup such as icons is supported. Leave it empty to render a tooltip without a title.

slots.name: toggle
slots.description: toggle` slot, raw HTML for the trigger element, it must carry `slot="toggle"`. Any element works: `s-button`, `s-avatar`, `s-tag`, an icon or plain inline text.

uploader.name: Uploader
uploader.description: Uploader component allows users to upload files with various layouts and configurations. It supports drag & drop, multiple files, file type restrictions, and preview functionality.

props.name: allowAlt
props.description: Show the ALT text button/editor under each file preview

props.name: autoUpload
props.description: Enable auto upload to server (deprecated, use server.instantUpload instead)

props.name: cropShapes
props.description: Crop shapes for image cropping (e.g., '1:1' or ['1:1', '9:16', '1.91:1']). Restricts cropping to only these shapes.

props.name: hasPreview
props.description: Show only preview without uploader area

props.name: headers
props.description: Custom headers for upload (deprecated, use server.headers instead)

props.name: hideBrowseButton
props.description: Hide the built-in browse button and keep only the actions slotted by the consumer (thumbnail layout only)

props.name: instantEdit
props.description: Automatically open the image editor after upload completes (thumbnail layout only)

props.name: label
props.default: Browse or drag and drop files here

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of files (-1 for unlimited)

props.name: maxVideos
props.description: Opt-in cap on video files only (images stay governed by `max`). Unset = no video cap.

props.name: payloadParameters
props.description: Additional payload parameters (deprecated, use server.upload.additionalRequestData instead)

props.name: selectable
props.description: Allow users to select files as primary

props.name: server
props.description: Server configuration object for upload, edit, and remove operations

events.name: altTextChange
events.description: Event emitted when a file's alt text is changed. Provides the file information.

events.name: edit
events.description: Event emitted when a file is edited. Provides the edited file information.

events.name: fileUpload
events.description: Event emitted when an item is uploaded (deprecated, use upload instead).

events.name: remove
events.description: Event emitted when a file is deleted. Provides the deleted file information.

events.name: sort
events.description: Event emitted when a file is reordered. Provides file, newIndex, and oldIndex.

events.name: upload
events.description: Event emitted when an item is uploaded. Provides files, file, and error information.
